record.original_question: Construct explicit approximately Hadamard matrices A∈{−1,1}^{n×n} for which the distortion ratio C/c in inequalities of the form c√n‖x‖_2 ≤ ‖Ax‖_2 ≤ C√n‖x‖_2 is guaranteed to be small, preferably by much simpler constructions than the existing nontrivial ones.

evidence.quote: Problem 9.1 (Stefan Steinerberger). There should be many nice explicit constructions of approximately Hadamard matrices with C/c guaranteed to be small.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A matrix $A\in\{-1,1\}^{n\times n}$ is called an approximately Hadamard matrix if there exist constants $0<c\le C<\infty$ such that
$$c\sqrt{n}\,\|x\|_2 \;\le\; \|Ax\|_2 \;\le\; C\sqrt{n}\,\|x\|_2 \qquad \text{for all } x\in\mathbb{R}^n.$$
The smaller the distortion ratio $C/c$, the closer $A/\sqrt{n}$ is to an orthogonal matrix.

Existence of approximately Hadamard matrices is known for every $n\ge 1$ (with universal constants $c,C$ independent of $n$), but the known constructions are nontrivial.

Problem. For every $n\ge 1$, give an explicit construction of a matrix $A_n\in\{-1,1\}^{n\times n}$ that is approximately Hadamard with a small, explicit distortion ratio $C/c$, and which is substantially simpler than known constructions (for instance, given by a closed-form rule for its entries, an elementary recursive scheme, or a circulant/Toeplitz pattern with explicitly described first row). Quantify the resulting constants $c$ and $C$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of constructing simple explicit approximately Hadamard ±1 matrices in all dimensions with small distortion appears to remain open. Existence results (Dong–Rudelson) and explicit constructions via flat Littlewood polynomials and the Carroll–Eustice–Figiel iteration (achieving only ‖Ax‖ ≥ c·n^{0.431}‖x‖) are known, and recent 2024–2025 work (Steinerberger; "Asymptotically optimal approximate Hadamard matrices", 2025) continues to address it, indicating no fully simple explicit construction with guaranteed small C/c has been established.

status_evidence.title: A Note on Approximate Hadamard Matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Steinerberger uses flat Littlewood polynomials to give circulant approximate Hadamard matrices, while explicit constructions like Carroll–Eustice–Figiel only give ‖Ax‖ ≥ c·n^{0.431}‖x‖.
status_evidence.claim: Known explicit constructions are either nontrivial or fall short of providing small distortion ratio.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotically optimal approximate Hadamard matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Recent 2025 work continues to study the problem of building approximate Hadamard matrices with optimal constants.
status_evidence.claim: The construction problem is still actively researched as of 2025.
